### Overall Assessment
A competent integration test design that demonstrates understanding of microservice testing patterns with good persona flavor. The response hits most requirements but lacks depth in test data isolation strategies and leaves too many implementation details as "exercise for the reader." The Data persona is well-executed with characteristic precision and subtle android humor, though the technical content could have been more thorough given the complexity of the challenge.
